The Bloom Room — Wedding Florals & Decor, Bengaluru

The Bloom Room is a Bengaluru decor studio with a contemporary, florals-first
aesthetic — pastel palettes, hanging floral installations, and minimalist stage
designs popular with couples wanting an elegant, Instagram-friendly look.

Their standard decor packages start at ₹2,00,000, with premium installations at
₹4,50,000. They specialize in fresh-flower-heavy designs and seasonal blooms.
